saw_lines: Style advice gets bought by people unsure of their body shape, and they want proof it fits someone like them first.
So the body shape has to appear in line one, because generic promises give an unsure buyer no reason to click.
Your 67 Google creatives include lines like “Expected an object,” so rewrite the text ads around a body shape and one clear promise.
